title: Words to read and colour: An-Nasr
subject: Qur'an & Tajweed
unit: Spring 2: An-Nasr, Al-Kafirun and reading joined words
source: Written for quran/y1 lesson 27 (Pupil PDF worksheet: words to read and colour)
intro: Lesson 27. Read each word slowly to a grown-up, then colour the part we learned today (An-Nasr). Then trace and copy.

arabic.text: إِذَا جَآءَ نَصْرُ ٱللَّهِ وَٱلْفَتْحُ (١) وَرَأَيْتَ ٱلنَّاسَ يَدْخُلُونَ فِى دِينِ ٱللَّهِ أَفْوَاجًۭا (٢) فَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ وَٱسْتَغْفِرْهُ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ تَوَّابًۢا (٣)

panels.title: What it teaches
points: People joined Islam in big groups

questions.q: Say An-Nasr together, then each ayah in turn.
Listening turns: today's group says An-Nasr to the teacher. Everyone else draws three hearts on the pupil PDF and writes SubhanAllah, alhamdulillah and astaghfirullah inside.
Extend: say astaghfirullah ten times before bed.
Which do we say to ask Allah to forgive us?
Think again: Allah says people came into Islam in big groups (110:2). How do you think the Prophet ﷺ felt?
questions.a: Happy and thankful. And Allah told him to praise Him and ask forgiveness (110:3).
